quest.title: An Omen of Annihilation and the Final Entreaty
quest.description: To enter the Heart of the Sacred Mountain, one need only offer up two Golden Entreaties... That should dispel the Flamelord's Blessing that presently affects your saurian buddy...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x400, Primogem x50, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x4, The Cornerstone of Stars and Flames x1

talks.objective: Head to the device at the center of the Heart of the Sacred Mountain

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: At this rate, the disordered power will devour your frail body utterly.

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: Even so, you surprise me... I did not expect that you could use the power within your blood to such an extent without having received the proper guidance...

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: Come, accept the guidance of the true Sacred Flame. Let the power bear you up, rather than use your body to bear this power.

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: Come forth—

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: Long have I awaited you, Chosen o{RUBY#[D]Dragonborn Who Braved the Flame and Returned}f Dragons.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As the light floats around you, the rampaging power within your body seems to circulate, submitting to some ever-shifting cycle.\nYour body seems to adapt to this change...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: It is just like the moment when you gained wisdom from the liquid Phlogiston you immersed yourself in.\nCountless images flow into your mind, following the circulating power, almost as if they are being reassembled and read out to you.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "Come, I have something to show you."\nThe speaker's voice seems immeasurably distant, and after that, both your body and consciousness fall into a white abyss...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: The reaver from beyond the skies once froze Xiuhcoatl in lava, causing him to fall into a false death...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: But when the Dragon King Nibelung descended from beyond the circles of this world, he was called forth by the Abyss and awoke from his long dream.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: The reaver annihilated the great black-winged lord at great cost... And at that moment, our fiery sovereign, who had been steeped in the Abyss, regained brief, tragic clarity.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: As he saw it then, this realm, once ruled by wisdom's blazing light, now lay shattered... A land once suffused by primal flame was now corroded by the dark foe, cankered and covered head to toe in sores.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Having himself become a breeding ground for darkness, his periods of clarity ever shortening, he knew not when he would become lost to senseless, twisted nothingness...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: In truth, in his final days, he may as well have restarted his false death, for all the difference it made. All the while, his entire race had become a gaggle of squawking fools...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Now that you possess true wisdom, I have little doubt that you, too, understand how it feels to be a changed being.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: And so, Xiuhcoatl used the last of the time and wisdom left to him to transform the dragon city once more and create the Tzitzimimeh...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: And finally, Huitzilopochtli.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: What is Huitzilopochtli?

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: The Natlan Phlogistonization Array... That is to say, a device that can transform all Natlan into "a land of only phlogiston, or only of matter comprised of phlogiston."

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Phlogiston is an atom upon which information may be transcribed, and is itself a form of "computronium" — an element that can be used to imitate the essence of any and all things through the weaving of{RUBY#[D]Iridescent Inscriptions} language.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: This is why phlogiston can take on different forms and even switch between them, and this is also why you could see phantoms at the repair mechanisms in the Chamber of Deliberation.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Huitzilopochtli will burn everything, and all that information will be logged and replicated by that ocean of phlogiston units...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Turning all Natlan into a realm composed solely of primal flame.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: When that happens, the moment the Abyss approaches, the Astral Assemblages created by the primal flame will automatically attach to them, using mutual annihilation reactions to consign our shadowy foe to oblivion.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: The Abyss shall never again be allowed even to gaze upon this realm.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: But, all the lives in Natlan...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: They will die by Huitzilopochtli's hand, or they can forsake their bodies and become pure phlogiston-based lifeforms...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: There shall be neither Ley Lines nor substantive bodies... We shall own everything, yet never again own anything. We shall be beholden to neither birth nor death. Perhaps even life's meaning shall become null and void to us.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: At that time, those dragons who have discarded their bodies and become phlogiston lifeforms shall become the rulers of the "new world."

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: That's... terrifying...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: So I thought, too, when this plan was first revealed to me...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: At the time, I believed that should this come to pass, all life would simply become flickering, illusory shadows cast by a titanic torch. Having lost our bodies, we would be bereft of any possibility to continue evolving...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: But no Dragonborn who serves Xiuhcoatl could refuse his orders.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: So, I sought another path... Hmm, perhaps I should don another guise for this bit?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Bona...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Well, what do you think? Quite fascinating, no? Things such as this are easily possible through proper phlogiston manipulation via Iridescent Inscriptions.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: I... kinda want to puke...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Hahaha, what an interesting response... Alright, now, let's head to Tonatiuh to search for that now non-existent Jade of Return, shall we?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yeah, not a moment to lose!

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrah... Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, don't you worry. C'mon, let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: This is a tower that allows Huitzilopochtli to cover all Natlan and anchor its areas of coverage...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Most of them were destroyed at Och-Kan's orders, but their fragments serve the same purpose anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: They never imagined that the carrier medium was something far smaller and more delicate, to the point that even a single stone could contain Iridescent Inscriptions...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Had they found out, my plans now would have been rendered impossible.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: On Tonatiuh...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: A place where I stored the Golden Entreaty, alongside this place.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: ...I once believed that humanity could create a civilization still more glorious. After Xbalanque's apotheosis, I even thought that they might avoid the dead end we walked into.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: So I decided to give them more time.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: But... Too many years have gone by.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: None amongst the tribes have even dared — not since Och-Kan — to establish a united empire.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Until today, they lean on the authority of their so-called "Archon" like a crutch... They were unable to forge weapons for themselves to wield, such that their world might be defended from the all-corrupting dark.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Their way of fighting against the great shadow... still lies in their stale stories of heroic valor, passed from generation to generation.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: So consumed are they with the past that they dare not risk it all.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Each time our foe strikes from the shadows, the slowly accumulated fruits of civilization are destroyed all in an instant, and afterward, there is only the eternal cycle, or worse, inexorable devolution...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: The time I granted as grace has lost all meaning as a result.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Perhaps if I gave them a few thousand years more, perhaps several tens of thousands, they will create that glorious, shining epoch, but my faith has run out.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: And waiting... Waiting has become a luxury, whether it be for me, or this once-sealed Sacred City.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Come. This story is almost at its end.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Let me witness your choice.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Mine?

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Yes, Chosen o{RUBY#[D]Dragonborn Who Braved the Flame and Returned}f Dragons. I would hear your answer.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Behold, Huitzilopochtli... and its activation array.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Bring it to life. This way, our shadowy enemy may never again gain a foothold upon this place... And afterward, via the gradual expansion of the primal flame's power...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: ...Just like when a complete bubble is blown within the leaking husk of an old one...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: ...Perhaps the entire world shall become free from Abyssal poison.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: But the authority over primal flame...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: When Natlan is fully phlogistonized, the very concept of life will be rewritten. That authority will then return naturally.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Only draconic phlogiston lifeforms may wield this authority. As such, you can become the shaper of this "new world." You can also become the Pyro Dragon Sovereign renewed.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: ...No, I suspect that any such rulership would be something entirely new, surpassing our traditional conceptions.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Then, you shall reclaim all light, all heat, all wisdom, bringing all order and great glory back to this realm — even to this world.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Even if doing so means the end of evolution?

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Who knows? Perhaps it will instead prove the beginning of a new evolutionary cycle. Stopping on the path leading onward can be another form of bravery, especially when the alternative is infinite regression.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Now then, choose. Activate Huitzilopochtli.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: (Draw near... and then feel...)

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: #No, wait! {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Oh my. And here I thought you wouldn't be able to remember them.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Never mind how your mind now has at least a thousand years' worth of memories within it... I also intended for you to make your decision while having forgotten them.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} was never meant to have existed here — though of course, it was precisely due to {M#his}{F#her} aid that you were able to reach this place.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: #{M#He}{F#She} is, however, rather special... It may be that the phlogistonization of Natlan will not affect {M#him}{F#her}...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: It "may be"...!?

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: No one knows what will happen once it is activated... Perhaps there shall then be no difference between you and me. Perhaps we shall both be destroyed.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: #Perhaps {M#he}{F#she} and that little emissary by {M#his}{F#her} side will live. Perhaps they will not.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: ...Hah, enough of that. Time is short. We do not have much excess energy left to also maintain those of our kind who have already become phlogiston lifeforms.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: If we do not obtain the authority over the primal flame in time, all shall soon perish. And once that moment comes, choice itself will be lost to us.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Quickly... Choose, O Chosen of Dragons!

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: "This is an omen of new life, and also the final entreaty"—

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: Entering trigger sequence. Three rounds of confirmations will be required to either activate or deactivate the Sweeping{RUBY#[D]Sunquake} Skyfire...

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: First confirmation. Are you certain that you wish to activate Huitzilopochtli?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew. Guess it's finally over...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Chosen of Dragons... You have completed every trial set before you...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The Flamelord's Blessing has been dispelled!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: The curse has been lifted.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, guess it's finally over.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Paimon was gonna say, for you to have grown up this big and yet still be safe, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could it be that fighting was just what was needed to remove the bloodline curse?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Still, that Sage of the Stolen Flame weirdo didn't show up, not even once...

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Uworrgh...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait, what's wrong? Were you hurt during the battle?

response.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
response.text: Grroo...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Chosen of Dragons, I chose you... after much deliberation...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And you have my thanks, for all you have done. I have always believed in you, I...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Ah... It is hard for me to say this, {NICKNAME}...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Never forget... that I love you.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hey, {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}, what's gotten into you...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And... Hey, you're back to your normal size!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh-oh, this whole place is shaking. Is the volcano about to blow?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: #Let's get {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} out first!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Right — whoops, can't forget his scarf!

response.speaker: Kukulkan
response.text: So, this is as far as the maintenance functions go. I thought your technical skills could have taken us a bit further.

response.speaker: Kukulkan
response.text: Still, I... I finally understand how you felt, Xiuhcoatl, my great brother.

response.speaker: Kukulkan
response.text: I now know what it means to come to the end of one's days... To yearn to see this one thing done, or to receive that single clear answer — and to be willing to do anything to accomplish these goals.

response.speaker: Kukulkan
response.text: ...I imagine you'd scold me. Why are the things I say and do always worlds apart?

response.speaker: Kukulkan
response.text: If I had truly wished for a dragon to activate that system, should I not have raised them within the Sacred City, teaching them to hate this world? Why did I send them to be by a human's side?

response.speaker: Kukulkan
response.text: Perhaps... deep down, I still wished... to believe.

response.speaker: Kukulkan
response.text: But look. Isn't it wonderful? It made the same choice I made back then — and Och-Kan too, for that matter.

response.speaker: Kukulkan
response.text: ...My king, my elder brother, O lord who gave me life on the day you yourself were born... You once said that in my final moments, I would understand your desire.

response.speaker: Kukulkan
response.text: Haha, but it seems that on this point alone, I cannot concede...

choices.text: Did you see him, little guy?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that was weird. All that shaking, and all the volcano did was blow off just a little smoke...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We ran ourselves silly just for that!?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not that you had to run — we grabbed you and booked it... Still, you gave us quite the fright, fainting the way you did after the battle! Are you still feeling unwell?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hehe, sure sounds like the worst is over.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Anyway, so, is that Flamelord's Blessing gone now? But {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]} still has that mark on his head...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (Reach out to the little Tepetlisaurus...)

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: As you reach out your hand, he stands up straight on his hind legs, rubbing his horn gently against your palm.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: The mark, red as flame itself, has dimmed and cooled, no longer concealing that faint warmth.\nIt seems that whatever power it once had is gone now.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon can't help but feel like you were a bit smarter while you were bigger just now...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now, you... Well, you're back to looking a bit silly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: True, but he's *our* silly little guy. I like him just the way he is.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, yeah, but still!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Anyway, who'd have thought that we'd remove that Flamelord's Blessing, huh? We might just be on our way to writing ourselves a new legend, hehe!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: All this adventuring's made Paimon hungry, though... Should we go get some Blazed Meat Stew, or maybe a little cake...?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr? ...Grooar, mrrraa... Rawr! Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You wanna eat both? Pfft, you greedy little saurian!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But today's a day to celebrate, so sure — let's go right now!

talks.objective: Talk to the guide who has now emerged
Talk to the guide who has now emerged

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: Open your eyes, descendant of the Flamelord.

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: I believe this is the second time I have formally met you in this form.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Ra... *cough* Wait. My voice is...?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: And my body, too...

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: You have briefly achieved the form of a "mature dragon" after your power was channeled with the proper guidance. Were that not the case, that savage strength would have warped your form.

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: In an earlier eon, the phlogiston-rich soils that sustained Natlan were regarded by the heavenly reaver as a form of so-called "Holy Soil" phenomenon. They cast sky-nails down to destroy the land...

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: We dragons boast extreme adaptability and evolutionary capacity, but this was used against us — countless Dragonborn could only devolve so as to survive in present-day Natlan...

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: But their bloodline has not changed.

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: That which Xiuhcoatl would not admit, the mark on one's horn would prove... For in the beginning, it was through his horn that the Pyro Dragon Sovereign first transmitted flaming light and wisdom.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: So the removal of the Blessing was a lie you made up...

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: Only one of omission. If not guided correctly, this disordered power would indeed kill most saurians who bear the Blessing.

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: The only question became whether... we could control the Blessing's occurrence or not. The answer was... that we had a high chance of success.

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: But you do not speak falsely even so. I did intend to use a human to unseal the volcano, and use Xbalanque's oath to have a human bring back the other "Golden Entreaty"...

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: Which is why I created that legend in the first place. And I would not name it an honorable tactic — many are the great humans who have died for this cause.

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: ...But you will understand, in time, that I no longer had any other choice.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: So, the so-called Chosen of Dragons...

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: Refers to both the chosen dragon, and the chosen human who brings the dragon here.

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: It's just that, once you were brought here, the human's duty had already ended...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Now, only you can tread the final path.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: (Huh? Wait a minute, those words... They ring in my head... Why?)

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: Now, you have mastered the way Dragonborn speak — a distant thing, indeed, from the brute cries of Natlan's saurian-kind...

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: And if you willed it, you could have any intelligent being understand your words.

dialogues.speaker: One Who Speaks Coldly
dialogues.text: Indeed, the phlogiston within your body, and the information and wisdom passed down from antiquity through the primal flame will also begin emerging.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: You're... the Sage of the Stolen Flame?

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: That is what the humans named me... Waxaklahun Ubah Kan, too, is also one of the many names I created.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: But "Kukulkan" was... Ah, forget it. Though all names will very soon become meaningless, you may simply call me that for now.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: (Hmm... Strange. I feel like I've forgotten something very important...)

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Confused? Well, it is quite normal to, after having re-attained wisdom, be flooded by the sea of information.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: But if you'd like me to assuage your discomfort, allow me to change into a form you'll find more familiar...

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Grroo...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Well, what do you think? Quite convenient, no? Should you desire it, our transformative arts will reveal themselves to you with but a thought... though you will require the help of some little souls too.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: It's fine. I'm happy the way "I" am.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Fair enough. "Forgive me for being presumptuous"... That is how the story began, no? In that case, let us start this way, too.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Anyway, come with me.

talks.objective: Speak to the one who names themselves "Kukulkan"
Speak to the one who names themselves "Kukulkan"

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Ah, Tonatiuh... Now that is a fine name. Before the false sky enveloped the world, the city that lay beneath it could have rivaled Tollan itself.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: In those days, while in search of light in the pitch-dark outer realms, we set up a... stairway? Hmm, no, it might be more correct to call it a cable to reach beyond our skies...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: And before Och-Kan spun it around, we had been preparing to leave it beyond our orbit and use it to tighten the sky-cable and anchor the latter's trajectory.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Later, it was modified to become Tonatiuh... It was originally intended to have hung higher in the sky... And then my beloved son, Och-Kan, hid a Golden Entreaty there.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: I once thought that through him, I could discover how the one seated upon heaven's throne converted the Ley Lines into a girdle that defends the planet. I believed that once I understood the secrets of its operation...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Then I could use this method to merge the human and dragon races, allowing dragon-kind to use subtler means to resist our great foe, the Abyss.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: ...And perhaps even allow the Dragonborn the right to once more glimpse truth beyond the skies.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: But you failed.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Indeed. Compared to the dragons, whose souls are more powerful and more uniform, the individual variation among human souls is far too great — and most of them are too fragile anyway.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Och-Kan... His spirit was like broken glass. He flew all too close to the sun, that he could become one with it. And close he got indeed — only to lose his shape as a result.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: He was so alike to my old self, and just as disappointing.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: ...Just like humanity itself. Perhaps I came into contact with them because I, too, once shared their frailties and harbored fantasies of overcoming the strong even in my weakness.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: And such a fantasy came true once, when Xbalanque seized upon Xiuhcoatl's weak point and slew him.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: A weak point, you say?

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Xiuhcoatl was the master of the first flame, wielder of all light, heat, and wisdom. He controlled the primal flame, and could even plunge his entire body into it.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: By all rights, at that time, there was no way he could have been harmed...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: If he had not modified one of his pupils to serve as the control hub for Huitzilopochtli, that is.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Because he had to monitor and anchor reality using this "eye," it became his sole weakness.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: That is how Xbalanque was able to take him down alongside himself.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Wait, they died together?

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Yes. Xbalanque was undoubtedly slain at that time... But he was reborn then, and thus became the so-called god of fire, the Pyro Archon.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Perhaps he paid the price for this death delayed, or perhaps this was part of the deal he had made with a certain entity all along.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Whatever the case, he knew what Huitzilopochtli was, and naturally, my alliance with him through Och-Kan was meant to prevent its activation.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Enter, then, the Golden Entreaties — the control hub that could be used to reactivate this place, split in two between us for safekeeping.

talks.objective: Speak to the one who names themselves "Kukulkan"

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alright, then. Are we heading into the Heart of the Sacred Mountain now?

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Huitzilopochtli has ceased operation. So, this is your decision, I presume?

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Why did you do it?

dialogues.speaker: NPC#21816
dialogues.text: I still believe in humanity. And...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#21816
dialogues.text: #I will not put {NICKNAME} and Paimon at risk.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: ...And yet, you may not hold the same pride of place in their hearts.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Are they not adventurers who roam the world? Perhaps it was only out of charity, or the desire to gain treasure or some other reward, that they brought you here.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Perhaps, in their hearts, they even harbor grievances against the nuisance you make of yourself, "rawr"-ing this way and that as you do.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#21816
dialogues.text: What they think of me matters little.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#21816
dialogues.text: They, however, are important to me. That's what really counts.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: You... You have no idea what folly you have chosen, or what you shall now lose...

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: There is still time, you know.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#21816
dialogues.text: I will not activate it.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Even... Even if the wisdom and power you enjoy now will fade without the primal flame's aid?

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: It was the fire I allotted to you that granted you that intellect... Yet deprived of our primal source, we shall merely share the feeblest of flames between two meager matches.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Soon, everything here shall cease to exist, and you will lose both your strength and powers of speech.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: #How will you tell your {NICKNAME} and Paimon of this world that you almost gained, yet in the end, lost?

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: They don't have to know about something as silly as this.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Fool.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: You do not even know where they are, nor is there any way back from this place.

dialogues.speaker: NPC#21816
dialogues.text: If there isn't a way back to them...

dialogues.speaker: NPC#21816
dialogues.text: ...Then I'll make one.

talks.objective: Step out onto the path you have created

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: So, this is as far as the maintenance functions go. I thought your technical skills could have taken us a bit further.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Still, I... I finally understand how you felt, Xiuhcoatl, my great brother.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: I now know what it means to come to the end of one's days... To yearn to see this one thing done, or to receive that single clear answer — and to be willing to do anything to accomplish these goals.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: ...I imagine you'd scold me. Why are the things I say and do always worlds apart?

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: If I had truly wished for a dragon to activate that system, should I not have raised them within the Sacred City, teaching them to hate this world? Why did I send them to be by a human's side?

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Perhaps... deep down, I still wished... to believe.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: But look. Isn't it wonderful? It made the same choice I made back then — and Och-Kan too, for that matter.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: ...My king, my elder brother, O lord who gave me life on the day you yourself were born... You once said that in my final moments, I would understand your desire.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: Haha, but it seems that on this point alone, I cannot concede...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wh—Whaa! We're about to be trapped!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: H... Huh? Nothing happened? Wait, no — did you save us?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Ermm? ... Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh, if you've grown this big, does that mean that you've recovered?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could it be that...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Careful! This fight isn't over yet!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, right, and there's still that big guy!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Perhaps we should prepare a bit first.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rrroar...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, good point...

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: Present the Golden Entreaties, Chosen of Dragons...

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: Ignite the Sacred Flame to cleanse creation.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #So, once we're in there, we can activate the Sacred Flame and cure {REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That way, he'll be able to grow up healthy, right?

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: Rawr!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Thinking back on it, we sure have done tons of stuff on this journey... and cleared loads of trials created by that Sage of the Stolen Flame guy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We even had a bust-up with Och-Kan, that super famous tyrant... Well, he turned out to be Coco in the end, and not as bad a guy as we thought...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: And come to think of it, all that Sage of the Stolen Flame stuff was kinda weird, but...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Heh, whatever. Let's get going!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Confirm activation.

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: "Sweeping Skyfire" generator is on approach. Supplying energy.

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: Calibration initiated.

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: Second confirmation. Are you certain that you wish to activate Huitzilopochtli?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Confirm activation.

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: "Sweeping Skyfire" generator is continuing its approach.

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: Phlogiston flow strength increased. Accelerating...

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: High ambient heat detected.

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: Third confirmation. Are you certain that you wish to activate Huitzi{RUBY#[D]Sunquake}lopochtli?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Confirm activation.

dialogues.speaker: Kukulkan
dialogues.text: ...So this is your choice, then? Ah... Yes. This, too, is fine. Perhaps I should have made the same choice as you, all those years ago... Even though... Ah, how regrettable...

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: ...Third confirmation complete.

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: "Sweeping Skyfire" generator at closest possible proximity.

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: Collision... gather... Final... complete...

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: ...destroyed, and thus welcome...

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: The moment of rebirth.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Before you stretches a world of pure white.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: None can know what light means in this realm, for it permeates every corner.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Nor does time retain any meaning — ten million years pass in what seems but a moment.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: ..."It," or something that was once "it," is the sole remaining consciousness.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Many great and mighty things happened in the world-that-once-was. Countless wars of inconceivable scale, battles that tore dimensions asunder, uncounted lives swallowed and transformed... Until the blazing light devoured the most primordial rule.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: But still, for reasons none can know, only "it" remains.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: This is a world the shadow can never again threaten, but is it a world with any meaning?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: "It" knows that the primal flame is not inexhaustible, though it shall burn for billions of years in this dark cosmic sea.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Sometimes, "it" recalls, as if in a dream, travels it once embarked on alongside two companions when the land was still tangible.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Holding onto these memories, "it" thinks it might yet endure the torment until death comes upon eternity's far shore.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Still, "it" recalls, time and again...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: If it could return to that moment, was there... another choice?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Cancel activation!

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: Results confirmed...

dialogues.speaker: Huitzilopochtli
dialogues.text: "Sweeping Skyfire" activation sequence has been canceled.

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: #(Rrrawr? White Floaty and {NICKNAME} are... locked up?)

dialogues.speaker: #{REALNAME[ID(2)|SHOWHOST(true)]}
dialogues.text: (Must... open... Must open! Must open!!!)
